title: I knelt once before today
html_source:
Bloom knelt at Dignam’s funeral earlier that day.
“Mr Bloom stood behind near the font and, when all had knelt, dropped carefully his unfolded newspaper from his pocket and knelt his right knee upon it.”

anchor.prefix: e.) I can make a true black knot. Learned when 1922#496I served my time and worked the mail order line for Kellett's. Experienced hand. Every knot says a lot. Let me. In courtesy.
